scenes.title: Open — voice command (side view)
scenes.description: Cold open: side view at Tommy Trojan, yeti speaks the command into his phone. No text overlay.
scenes.vo: Yeti (spoken, no caption): “Find me hiring managers at Doogle.”
scenes.notes: Walking intro cut per Nick. Full 4s clip.

scenes.title: Scout responds — on his phone
scenes.description: Macro of the phone in his paw: 'On it — drafting your outreach.' types out. This IS what's on his phone.
scenes.notes: Standalone UI insert cut per Nick — phone content lives in these in-paw shots.

scenes.title: Emailing 5 hiring managers
scenes.description: Avatars fill along the progress line, send icon glows.

scenes.title: Send — blur into the icon
scenes.description: Dive into the send icon; clip ENDS in a full blue flare that match-cuts into the flight.
scenes.notes: Play full length — do not trim the flare.

scenes.title: Mail streaks over LA
scenes.description: Envelope rockets over sunlit LA, ends on sun-flare blur.
scenes.notes: Full length into the desk landing.

scenes.title: Lands on the hiring manager's desktop
scenes.description: Envelope sinks into the monitor through the window light, ripple rings, she leans in.

scenes.title: Zoom out — LA skyline, mail into buildings
scenes.description: Wide daytime aerial: trails dive into towers, camera pulls back.

scenes.title: One tower lights up green
scenes.description: One tower pulses green, camera dives toward it.

scenes.title: Hiring manager replies
scenes.description: She types the reply, green compose glow, confident final key press.

scenes.title: Reply flies back (same transition)
scenes.description: Green envelope arcs from the skyline back to campus — mirrors the outbound blur transition.
scenes.notes: Full length so the arc lands before the cut.

scenes.title: Yeti tells the class
scenes.description: Cut straight to the yeti: eyes widen, he spins to the students behind him, then points at the screen.
scenes.vo: Yeti: “Oh my god. Wait — I got an interview!”

scenes.title: ...and shows the computer
scenes.description: Fade to the actual email full-frame; slow push-in.
scenes.notes: Ken Burns in Remotion; text legible.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.vo: Say it. Scout does it. / Try Offerloop free / offerloop.ai
scenes.notes: Rendered by Remotion endCard scene — no asset.
